natural: Taking separate roads and riding off

meaning.en: To part ways; to go separate directions because of different goals.
meaning.zh: 分路而行。比喻因目标不同而各奔各的前程。

examples.zh: 两位创始人因理念不同分道扬镳。
examples.en: The two founders parted ways over their different visions.

examples.zh: 这支乐队合作十年后终于分道扬镳。
examples.en: After ten years together, the band finally went their separate ways.

story.en: Two officials argued over who should yield the road in Luoyang. Emperor Xiaowen ruled that they should "take separate roads and raise their bridles" (分路扬镳) — each go his own way.
story.zh: 元志与李彪争道，北魏孝文帝说："洛阳我之丰沛，自应分路扬镳。"

usage.en: Predicate. Partners, bands, couples and allies. 镳 is biāo.

synonyms: 你走你的阳关道，我过我的独木桥
antonyms: 一根绳拴俩蚂蚱——谁也跑不了

natural: Vividly alive

meaning.en: Vivid and lifelike, as if real.
meaning.zh: 形容神情逼真，使人感到好像亲眼看到一般。

examples.zh: 他把当时的情景讲得活灵活现。
examples.en: He described the scene so vividly you could almost see it.

examples.zh: 画上的小猫活灵活现，好像要跳出来。
examples.en: The kitten in the painting is so lifelike it looks ready to jump out.

usage.en: Predicate or complement (讲得活灵活现).

natural: In the same boat through wind and rain

meaning.en: To stand together through hard times.
meaning.zh: 在风雨中同乘一条船。比喻共同经历患难。

examples.zh: 他们夫妻风雨同舟走过了五十年。
examples.en: The couple have stood together through thick and thin for fifty years.

examples.zh: 困难时期，全体员工风雨同舟，公司挺了过来。
examples.en: In the hard times all the staff pulled together, and the company survived.

story.en: Sunzi notes that the people of Wu and Yue hate each other, yet "when crossing in the same boat and caught by wind, they help each other like left and right hands".
story.zh: 《孙子·九地》："夫吴人与越人相恶也，当其同舟而济，遇风，其相救也如左右手。"

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Couples, partners, nations in crisis.

synonyms: 文章满纸书生累，风雨同舟战友贤

natural: Idle hands and a love of leisure

meaning.en: To loaf about and avoid work.
meaning.zh: 游荡懒散，不爱劳动。

examples.zh: 他毕业后一直游手好闲，不找工作。
examples.en: Since graduating he's just been loafing about without looking for work.

examples.zh: 父母最担心孩子变得游手好闲。
examples.en: What parents fear most is their child becoming a layabout.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 好 is hào (to love).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"好"读 hào。

natural: Lightning flashing and thunder rumbling

meaning.en: A thunderstorm; lightning flashing and thunder roaring. Also very fast and forceful.
meaning.zh: 闪电划过，雷声轰鸣。也比喻快速、有力。

examples.zh: 半夜里电闪雷鸣，孩子吓得哭了。
examples.en: There was thunder and lightning in the night, and the child cried with fright.

examples.zh: 一时间电闪雷鸣，大雨倾盆而下。
examples.en: Suddenly lightning flashed, thunder roared and rain poured down.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Mostly literal weather description.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多用于描写天气。

natural: Its mouth sealed three times

meaning.en: To keep one's mouth shut; to be cautious and say nothing.
meaning.zh: 在嘴上贴了三道封条。形容说话谨慎，也指不肯开口。

examples.zh: 记者追问内情，发言人却三缄其口。
examples.en: Reporters pressed for details, but the spokesperson stayed tight-lipped.

examples.zh: 在这个问题上，他一向三缄其口。
examples.en: He has always kept his lips sealed on this issue.

story.en: In the ancestral temple of Zhou, Confucius saw a bronze figure whose mouth was sealed three times, with an inscription warning: "The ancients were cautious in speech."
story.zh: 《孔子家语》：孔子观周，"入后稷之庙，堂右阶之前，有金人焉，三缄其口，而铭其背曰：古之慎言人也。"

usage.en: Predicate. Often about officials refusing to comment.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指不肯表态。

literal: scale · order · comb-teeth · side by side
natural: Lined up like fish scales and comb teeth

meaning.en: (Of buildings) closely packed in neat rows.
meaning.zh: 像鱼鳞和梳子齿那样有次序地排列着。多形容房屋密集。

examples.zh: 市中心高楼鳞次栉比。
examples.en: Skyscrapers stand row upon row in the city centre.

examples.zh: 古镇上鳞次栉比的老房子很有味道。
examples.en: The closely packed old houses of the ancient town are full of character.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Mostly about buildings and shops. 栉 is zhì.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，多形容房屋、店铺。"栉"读 zhì。

natural: Pull the firewood from under the pot

meaning.en: To solve a problem at its root; to remove the source of trouble.
meaning.zh: 把锅底下的柴火抽掉。比喻从根本上解决问题。

equivalents: take the wind out of someone's sails
pull the rug out from under

examples.zh: 要治理污染，必须釜底抽薪，关停违规工厂。
examples.en: To tackle pollution, we must cut it off at the source and shut down illegal factories.

examples.zh: 对方釜底抽薪，挖走了我们的核心技术人员。
examples.en: Our rival pulled the rug out from under us by poaching our key engineers.

origin.source: 魏收《为侯景叛移梁朝文》；《三十六计》

story.en: Wei Shou wrote: "pull out the firewood to stop the boiling, cut the weeds and remove the roots" (抽薪止沸，剪草除根). It later became one of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.
story.zh: 魏收："抽薪止沸，剪草除根。"后为《三十六计》之一。

date.zh: 明清之际 · 17世纪（成书年代不详）

usage.en: Predicate or attributive (釜底抽薪的办法). 釜 is fǔ.

natural: Courage trembling, heart alarmed

meaning.en: Terrified; trembling with fear.
meaning.zh: 形容十分害怕。

examples.zh: 走在悬崖边的小路上，我胆战心惊。
examples.en: Walking along the cliff-edge path, I was scared stiff.

examples.zh: 那部恐怖片看得人胆战心惊。
examples.en: That horror film had everyone quaking in their boots.

usage.en: Predicate or complement. Also 心惊胆战.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语。也作"心惊胆战"。

natural: Firm, tough and impossible to uproot

meaning.en: Firm and unyielding; tenacious.
meaning.zh: 形容意志坚定，不可动摇。

examples.zh: 成功需要坚韧不拔的毅力。
examples.en: Success requires tenacious perseverance.

examples.zh: 他以坚韧不拔的精神完成了横渡海峡的壮举。
examples.en: With dogged determination he completed the feat of swimming the strait.

usage.en: Attributive (坚韧不拔的意志/精神).

synonyms: 古之立大事者，不惟有超世之才，亦必有坚忍不拔之志

natural: Raising the dead back to life

meaning.en: To bring back from the dead; to revive something hopeless.
meaning.zh: 使死人复活。形容医术高明，也比喻把处于绝境的事物挽救过来。

examples.zh: 新管理团队让这家濒临倒闭的公司起死回生。
examples.en: The new management brought the near-bankrupt company back from the dead.

examples.zh: 医生再高明，也不能起死回生。
examples.en: However brilliant a doctor is, they can't raise the dead.

usage.en: Predicate. Figurative use (businesses, teams) is very common.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，比喻用法很常见。

natural: Pouring one's whole spirit into it

meaning.en: With complete concentration; totally absorbed.
meaning.zh: 全部精神集中在一点上。形容注意力高度集中。

examples.zh: 他全神贯注地盯着棋盘。
examples.en: He stared at the chessboard in total concentration.

examples.zh: 手术时，医生全神贯注，不敢有一丝分心。
examples.en: During the operation, the surgeons were totally focused.

usage.en: Usually adverbial (全神贯注地). Very common in school writing.

natural: Escaping alive from the jaws of death

meaning.en: To have a narrow escape from death.
meaning.zh: 从极危险的境地中逃脱，幸免于死。

equivalents: escape by the skin of one's teeth

examples.zh: 他在地震中死里逃生。
examples.en: He had a narrow escape in the earthquake.

examples.zh: 经历了死里逃生，她更加珍惜生活。
examples.en: Having cheated death, she treasures life all the more.

usage.en: Predicate. Accidents, disasters, battles.

natural: Safe and sound with nothing amiss

meaning.en: Safe and sound; all well, with nothing untoward happening.
meaning.zh: 平平安安，没有发生事故。

examples.zh: 一路平安无事，我们顺利到达了。
examples.en: The journey was uneventful and we arrived safely.

examples.zh: 只要大家平安无事就好。
examples.en: As long as everyone's safe, that's all that matters.

usage.en: Predicate. Everyday and reassuring.

natural: Decide on the spot when the moment comes

meaning.en: To make a prompt decision at the critical moment.
meaning.zh: 抓住时机，立即作出决断。

examples.zh: 船长当机立断，下令所有人弃船。
examples.en: The captain made a snap decision and ordered everyone to abandon ship.

examples.zh: 面对危机，领导者必须当机立断。
examples.en: In a crisis, a leader must act decisively.

usage.en: Predicate. Praises decisiveness. 当 is dāng.

natural: You could net sparrows at the gate

meaning.en: Deserted; very few visitors or customers.
meaning.zh: 大门前可以张网捕雀。形容门庭冷落，宾客稀少。

examples.zh: 新商场开业不久就门可罗雀。
examples.en: Soon after it opened, the new mall was like a ghost town.

examples.zh: 他失势以后，家里门可罗雀。
examples.en: After he lost power, hardly anyone came to his door.

story.en: When Lord Zhai was a high official, guests crowded his gate; when he lost office, "one could set up a sparrow net outside his gate" (门外可设雀罗). Sima Qian used it to show how fickle friendship is.
story.zh: 翟公为廷尉时宾客盈门，罢官后"门外可设雀罗"。

usage.en: Predicate. Shops, businesses, the homes of fallen officials.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，形容店铺、门庭冷落。

synonyms: 阎罗王做生意——鬼都不上门
万丈悬崖上的鲜桃——没人睬（采）

natural: Swaying and swinging grandly

meaning.en: To swagger; to walk in a conceited or brazen way.
meaning.zh: 走路时身子摇摇摆摆。形容自以为了不起、满不在乎的样子。

equivalents: as if one owns the place

examples.zh: 他没买票，却大摇大摆地走进了电影院。
examples.en: He hadn't bought a ticket but strolled into the cinema bold as brass.

examples.zh: 小偷大摇大摆地离开了现场。
examples.en: The thief swaggered away from the scene.

usage.en: Usually adverbial (大摇大摆地走). Implies arrogance or brazenness.
usage.zh: 多作状语，含傲慢或明目张胆之意。

natural: Diligent and earnest

meaning.en: Diligent and conscientious; hard-working.
meaning.zh: 形容勤劳踏实。

examples.zh: 他在这家工厂勤勤恳恳地干了一辈子。
examples.en: He worked conscientiously at the factory his whole life.

examples.zh: 她勤勤恳恳，深受同事尊敬。
examples.en: She's diligent and highly respected by her colleagues.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. An idiomatic AABB.

natural: Heart opened up and spirit delighted

meaning.en: Relaxed and happy; refreshed in body and mind.
meaning.zh: 心境开阔，精神愉快。

examples.zh: 站在山顶眺望远方，让人心旷神怡。
examples.en: Looking out from the mountaintop leaves you feeling completely refreshed.

examples.zh: 海边的清风吹得人心旷神怡。
examples.en: The sea breeze makes you feel relaxed and happy.

story.en: Fan Zhongyan's famous essay describes climbing Yueyang Tower on a bright spring day: "then the heart opens and the spirit is delighted; favour and disgrace are both forgotten" (心旷神怡，宠辱偕忘).
story.zh: 范仲淹《岳阳楼记》："登斯楼也，则有心旷神怡，宠辱偕忘，把酒临风，其喜洋洋者矣。"

usage.en: Predicate, often 令人心旷神怡. About scenery and fresh air.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"令人心旷神怡"。

synonyms: 登斯楼也，则有心旷神怡，宠辱偕忘，把酒临风，其喜洋洋者矣

natural: Understood in the heart but left unspoken

meaning.en: A tacit understanding; both know without saying it.
meaning.zh: 彼此心里明白，而不公开说出来。

examples.zh: 两人相视一笑，心照不宣。
examples.en: They smiled at each other — no words needed.

examples.zh: 这是行业内心照不宣的规则。
examples.en: It's an unwritten rule that everyone in the industry understands.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.

natural: The latecomer ends up on top

meaning.en: A latecomer overtakes those who came earlier.
meaning.zh: 后来的超过先前的。

examples.zh: 这家新公司后来居上，成了行业第一。
examples.en: The newcomer came from behind to become the industry leader.

examples.zh: 比赛最后一圈，他后来居上夺得冠军。
examples.en: On the last lap he overtook the leaders to win.

story.en: The blunt minister Ji An complained to Emperor Wu that he promoted officials "like stacking firewood — those who come later end up on top" (如积薪耳，后来者居上).
story.zh: 汲黯对汉武帝说："陛下用群臣，如积薪耳，后来者居上。"原带不满。

usage.en: Predicate. Now positive; originally a complaint about unfair promotion.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，现为褒义，原含不满。

synonyms: 新竹高于旧竹枝，全凭老干为扶持
antonyms: 黄鼠狼下豆鼠——一辈不如一辈

natural: Horses harnessed side by side, galloping together

meaning.en: To keep pace with each other; to be on a par.
meaning.zh: 几匹马并排拉着车一齐奔跑。比喻彼此不分前后，齐头并进。

examples.zh: 中国在这个领域已能与发达国家并驾齐驱。
examples.en: China can now keep pace with developed countries in this field.

examples.zh: 两家公司在市场上并驾齐驱。
examples.en: The two companies are neck and neck in the market.

usage.en: Predicate, often 与……并驾齐驱.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"与……并驾齐驱"。

natural: Stepping up of one's own accord

meaning.en: To volunteer for a difficult task.
meaning.zh: 主动要求承担某项艰巨的任务。

examples.zh: 没人愿意去，小王自告奋勇地报了名。
examples.en: Nobody wanted to go, so Xiao Wang volunteered.

examples.zh: 她自告奋勇担任了晚会的主持人。
examples.en: She stepped up to host the party.

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate.

natural: Rising again from the eastern mountain

meaning.en: To make a comeback after a setback or retirement.
meaning.zh: 指再度出任要职，也比喻失势后重新恢复地位。

examples.zh: 创业失败后，他总结教训，三年后东山再起。
examples.en: After his business failed he learned his lessons and made a comeback three years later.

examples.zh: 这位老将宣布复出，准备东山再起。
examples.en: The veteran announced his return, ready to stage a comeback.

story.en: The statesman Xie An lived in retirement on Dongshan (East Mountain) until his forties, then returned to office and led Jin to victory at the Battle of Fei River.
story.zh: 东晋谢安隐居会稽东山，四十多岁才出仕，后官至宰相，指挥了淝水之战。

usage.en: Predicate. Business failures, politics, sport.

synonyms: 留得青山在，不怕没柴烧
野火烧不尽，春风吹又生

natural: At the first drumbeat, morale is roused

meaning.en: To do something in one go, while enthusiasm is at its height.
meaning.zh: 第一次击鼓时士气振作。比喻趁劲头大的时候一下子把事情做完。

equivalents: strike while the iron is hot

examples.zh: 我们一鼓作气，把剩下的工作都做完了。
examples.en: We kept up the momentum and finished all the remaining work in one go.

examples.zh: 他一鼓作气爬到了山顶。
examples.en: He climbed to the summit in one go.

story.en: At the Battle of Changshao, Cao Gui held back Lu's troops until Qi had drummed three times. He explained: "The first drum rouses courage, the second weakens it, the third exhausts it" (一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭).
story.zh: 曹刿论战："夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。"

usage.en: Adverbial or predicate. In speech 一 is yì.
